# Brent Palmer — Product Designer

Brent Palmer is a product designer specializing in B2B SaaS, AI workflows, and enterprise systems.

## About

Product designer with experience leading design for complex, multi-sided platforms and AI-native tools. Based in the United States.

## Portfolio

- Homepage: /
- Work index: /work
- About: /about

## Case studies

- Zocdoc (/work/zocdoc): Designing onboarding for large, multi-location medical practices. Led the system model, onboarding flow, and dashboard design.
- Samepage (/work/samepage): From scattered inputs to structured updates. Designed an AI-powered status update system connecting work tools to structured communication.
- Tango (/work/tango): How-to guides that create themselves. Led design for the guide editor and sharing experience, reducing creation time from ~10 minutes to under 1 minute.
- Handraise (/work/handraise): Turning earned media into owned reach. Designed the lead capture and audience growth product.
